sentences.text: The South Australian Independent Commission Against Corruption investigated an allegation that a minister used his position to arrange a government contract for a personal associate.
It examined two unsolicited business proposals, the first rejected and the second accepted after agency assessment.
The Commissioner reported no direct evidence of corruption, but identified risks when private interests use ministerial connections for commercial benefit.
She called for objective assessment of unsolicited proposals and said she would separately recommend improvements to agency guidance.

items.quote: Ministers must be alive to the risk that those around them might attempt to influence them for personal or commercial gain.

Chief executives and other government decision makers must be unwavering in upholding their responsibility to ensure unsolicited proposals are given objective consideration that is in the public interest.
